titleEn: Maximum Matching of Players With Trainers
title: 运动员和训练师的最大匹配数
summary: 每名运动员需匹配能力不低于其要求的不同训练师，求最大匹配数。
insight: 双方升序排序，用当前最弱训练师尝试满足当前最弱未匹配运动员；能满足就配对并同时前进，否则换更强训练师。
pitfalls: 每人和训练师至多使用一次
优先满足较弱运动员保留强者

solutions.title: 排序双指针匹配
solutions.idea: 最小可行训练师贪心分配给当前运动员。
steps: 若 trainer>=player，matches++ 且 player++；无论如何 trainer++

code.java: class Solution { public int matchPlayersAndTrainers(int[] players,int[] trainers){Arrays.sort(players);Arrays.sort(trainers);int player=0,matches=0;for(int trainer:trainers)if(player<players.length&&trainer>=players[player]){player++;matches++;}return matches;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun matchPlayersAndTrainers(players:IntArray,trainers:IntArray):Int{players.sort();trainers.sort();var player=0;var matches=0;for(trainer in trainers)if(player<players.size&&trainer>=players[player]){player++;matches++};return matches} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int matchPlayersAndTrainers(vector<int>& players,vector<int>& trainers){sort(players.begin(),players.end());sort(trainers.begin(),trainers.end());int player=0,matches=0;for(int trainer:trainers)if(player<(int)players.size()&&trainer>=players[player]){++player;++matches;}return matches;} };
